implementation.name: Missile Command (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 30 HDL source files (1 systemverilog, 29 verilog) alongside 4 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: 1 MRA files in the repository's releases/ directory carry a <setname>; 1 resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 0 through MAME's own cloneof relation to the parent set that survives extract/machine.json's parents-only filter, giving 1 distinct machine_id rows. license_id omitted: the two license statements in the repository disagree. https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-MissileCommand_MiSTer/blob/main/LICENSE is the verbatim GNU GPL version 3 text, but the grant in https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-MissileCommand_MiSTer/blob/main/Arcade-MissileCommand.sv offers the work under GPL version 2 or later. Either reading is arguable and neither is a fact the repository states, so no SPDX id is asserted. hdl_language_id: 29 of 30 HDL files are verilog (1 systemverilog, 29 verilog), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
